_comment: Single source of truth for this stack's dev services. isopod regenerates code-server/settings.json (startup terminals), code-server/tasks.json, and services-start.sh from this file on every `isopod up`. Add one entry per long-running service. Fields: id, displayName, port, protocol(http|https), urlLabel, workdir, logPath, startCommand, stopPort, tailInTerminal(default true), autoStart(default true). A service with no startCommand is listed for its URL only (e.g. the IDE).
